fields.name: DT2
fields.fieldText:
Application Team

All non-related educational histories should NOT be attached to the new application.

Acknowledgement form built into the application


Confirm/verify

Permanent State = Florida (BSNP hybrid)

< 13 college credits

  • Official High School Transcript / Overall GPA 2.75
  • GED equivalent minimum score 145 in each subject area

> 13 college credits

  • All college transcripts / Overall GPA 2.75

TEAS Scores

  • Official score report needed
  • Overall 58.7 / Science 75
  • 3 attempts within 6 months
  • 1 month between attempts for remediation
  • 2nd attempt may be best to withdraw and prepare
  • 3rd failure: must wait 1 year from date of 3rd failure to retest

Castlebranch

  • Background Check / Drug Test

Enrollment Agreement

  • Automatically sent at time application is submitted
  • Ability to resend (screen flow)
  • Retrieved through Form Assembly
  • Valid 7 days
  • Needs student e-signature
  • Return for authorized EU signature
  • Enrollment Agreement Signed Queue
  • Download, sign, and upload to Hyland with Doctype ENRAGR

Nursing Disclosure

  • Automatically sent at time application is submitted
  • Ability to resend (screen flow)
  • Retrieved through Form Assembly
  • Valid for 7 days
  • Needs student e-signature
  • Nursing Disclosure Signed Queue
  • Download, sign, and upload to Hyland with Doctype PLNURDISC


If all documents aren’t received at the time of submission:

  • Place On Hold
  • Email student missing documents (email specific to BSNP)
  • Place “On Hold”

When all required documentation is received:

  • Ready for committee review — “YES” will change
  • Application status and application-facing status → Committee Review

Will be approved or denied (with rationale)

  • Denial email will go out automatically
  • Includes contact information to reach admissions counselor

TASK will be set in the application task queue:

  • “Committee Decision” = change status as appropriate

fields.name: Intro_CollegeGPA_HelpText
fields.fieldText:
Committee Review Team


Note: Before a final decision can be selected, the Application Committee is required to enter TEAS scores and at least one of the following:

  • College GPA
  • High school GPA
  • GED status

If a committee member has already entered values, they will be displayed on this screen but can be edited if needed. Clicking the Finish button below will save changes, even if a final decision has not been made.

fields.name: GPAHeader
fields.fieldText:
Fill in College GPA

·        Applicants who have 13 or more college credits need to have their cumulative GPA calculated. Use transcripts from Educational History Records and the GPA Calculator. Enter the college GPA in the field below:

fields.name: HSGPA_HelpText
fields.fieldText:
Fill in the HS GPA

·        Applicants with 12 or less college credits need to use their HS GPA. HS GPA is in the High School Educational History record. A link to the the record is below. View the record and enter the value in the High School GPA field below:

fields.name: GED_HelpText
fields.fieldText:
Fill in Meets Min GED if no College credits or no HS transcript

·        For GED, a passing score of 145 is needed for each section. GED score can be found in the GED Educational History record. View the record and select the appropriate value (yes/no).

fields.name: HelpText_TEASScore
fields.fieldText:
Fill in TEAS scores for each individual areas and overall score

  • TEAS Scores must be input into the Educational History Record related to the application. All TEAS scores submitted by the applicant will appear. If changes need to be made for a specific record, select the record, then the "change scores" box to reveal additional fields to edit.

fields.name: FinalUpdate
fields.fieldText:
﻿Complete Review: When review of the application is complete, you can set the final status by selecting either Approved or Denied. If no value is selected, you will return to this page when you return to this application.


Review the data entered above to answer the below questions. If all are "yes", the applicant is approved. If the answer to any question is "no", the applicant is denied. If denied, select the appropriate reason (Academic History, Low GPA or Low TEAS)

  • Is High School GPA or College Cumulative GPA at or above a 2.75?
  • If Applicable, Is the GED score of each subject area at or above a 145?
  • Is the TEAS Overall Score at or above a 58.7%?
  • Is the TEAS Science Subject Score at or above 75%?

fields.name: DeniedBlub

When the next button is selected, the application's Committee Review Status will change to the same value, and the Application Review Team will receive a task with the same information. The applicant will receive an email with details of this decision.
